column6: Both paragraphs convey the same core idea that effective functioning relies on strong systems and structures, emphasizing the importance of a solid foundation in doctrine for living as healthy or sound Christians.
column7: For things to function effectively, a solid system and structure are essential. Without them, dysfunction and chaos can easily arise. This is why establishing a strong foundation in doctrine is crucial for fully living as a healthy Christian.
column8: For anything to work effectively, robust systems and structures are essential. Without these, inefficiency and chaos can easily arise. Therefore, establishing a firm foundation in doctrine is extremely important in order to live fully as sound Christians.
